**Grow Existing Accounts:** 




 Look beyond the next order. Identify opportunities for repeat business, new product introductions, cross\-sell/up\-sell, better product mix and expansion into new channels or markets.
 



**Own the Numbers:** 




 Deliver agreed sales targets and stay close to the P\&L; of your accounts. Be comfortable discussing revenue, gross margin, contribution, pricing, discounts, trade terms, freight, marketing investments, payment terms and receivables.
 



**Hunt for New Business:** 




 Build a strong pipeline of distributors, importers and channel partners. Generate leads, qualify opportunities, make presentations, negotiate, close and turn new relationships into sustainable business.
 



**Understand the Market:** 




 Keep your eyes and ears open. Use customer conversations, market visits, industry networks and international travel to spot new markets, changing customer needs, competitive activity and opportunities for growth.
 



**Be the Customer’s Champion Internally:** 




 Understand customer demand and make sure the right teams know what is needed. Work closely with marketing, finance, supply chain, regulatory and product/R\&D; teams to deliver a smooth customer experience.
 



**Work Closely with Marketing:** 




 Bring customer and market insights to the marketing team and collaborate on launches, campaigns, product communication, samples, market activations and customer\-specific requirements.
 



**Negotiate with Confidence:** 




 Lead commercial conversations around pricing, margins, MOQs, payment terms, credit, exclusivity, marketing support, volume commitments and other account terms, while working within approved company frameworks.
 



**Make Trade Shows Count:** 




 Help plan and execute relevant international exhibitions and trade shows, including meeting schedules, samples, marketing materials and prospect engagement. Most importantly, turn conversations at the booth into qualified opportunities after the show.
 



**Travel \& Build Relationships:** 




 Travel internationally for customer meetings, distributor reviews, market visits, exhibitions and new business development. Be comfortable building genuine relationships across cultures and geographies.
 



**Plan Ahead:** 




 Maintain accurate forecasts and account plans, flag risks early and give the business clear visibility on expected orders, revenue and market developments.
 



**Stay Commercially Disciplined:** 




 Work with finance and customers to maintain healthy payment cycles, follow up on receivables and make sure growth is healthy as well as exciting.
 



**Share What You Learn:** 




 Bring customer feedback, competitor activity, pricing trends, category developments and emerging needs back to the wider team so that the business can move faster and smarter.
 



**Keep Things Moving:** 




 Maintain clear account, pipeline and activity records and provide regular updates on performance, opportunities, challenges and next steps.
 



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




 • 3–4 years of experience in international sales, business development or key account management, preferably working with distributors/importers.
 



 • Experience in nutraceuticals, sports nutrition, consumer health, FMCG, pharma, wellness, food \& beverage or related consumer categories is preferred.
 



 • Hands\-on experience working with customers across multiple countries, with a genuine willingness to travel internationally.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in business, International Business, Marketing, Commerce, Life Sciences or a related field. MBA is an advantage.
 



 • Fluent written and spoken English is a must.
 



  





**The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here** 




 • Commercially sharp, ambitious and hungry to grow.
 



 • Naturally good with people, with the confidence to build relationships and the humility to listen.
 



 • Energetic and proactive: someone who sees a problem and starts looking for a way through it.
 



 • Comfortable with numbers and genuinely interested in how the P\&L; works, not someone who leaves the spreadsheets to someone else.
 



 • Creative and resourceful when customers need solutions.
 



 • Resilient and persistent, especially when a promising deal takes longer than expected. International business occasionally enjoys testing human patience.
 



 • Collaborative and generous with knowledge, with a genuine willingness to support teammates and celebrate shared wins.
 



 • Curious about different markets, cultures, consumers and ways of doing business.
 



 • Passionate about building brands and businesses, while bringing kindness, respect and positive energy to the way they work.
 



  





**How Success Will Be Measured:** 




 Success in this role will be measured through a balanced combination of sales target achievement, portfolio revenue growth, account profitability/P\&L; performance, new business acquisition, qualified pipeline development, account retention, receivables discipline and forecast accuracy

 2\. Respond to enquiries across calls, WhatsApp and direct messages, progressing the pipeline through the working day
 



 3\. Manage incoming calls and walk in enquiries with the same qualification discipline applied to digital leads
 



 4\. Qualify enquiries through structured discovery and convert them into booked consultations
 



 5\. Improve the booked to attended ratio through timely reminders, rapport building and pre consultation preparation
 



 6\. Prepare clients ahead of their consultation and hand over to the clinical team with complete context, so that every consultation begins informed
 



 7\. Introduce complementary services where relevant to the client, and book consultations for the clinical team to advise and recommend
 



 8\. Conduct structured reach out campaigns to dormant client segments and contribute to monthly reactivation revenue
 



 9\. Record every client interaction, update enquiry stages promptly, and maintain database accuracy to the required standard
 



  





 Client experience at the clinic
 



  





 10\. Receive clients on arrival with the warmth and polish of a luxury wellness environment, manage the appointment book, and keep waiting times minimal and clearly communicated
 



 11\. Process billing and payments accurately, and record every amount received against the correct client, service and package
 



 12\. Coordinate between clients, therapists and doctors so that each day runs to schedule and every transition between services is seamless
 



 13\. Operate the clinic management system accurately and in real time across appointments, client records, billing and packages
 



 14\. Maintain the reception area, displays and client facing materials to the standard of the brand
 



 15\. Uphold the confidentiality, discretion and presentation standards expected of a premium clinical environment
 



  





 Performance and standards
 



  





 16\. Submit a daily performance update and participate in weekly funnel reviews with the sales team
 



 17\. Deliver against monthly performance targets covering revenue contribution, enquiry connection, qualification, consultation bookings, attendance rate, walk in conversion and database reactivation
 



 18\. Represent Reaviva in a manner that is informed, courteous and consultative at all times
 



  





 Requirements
 



  





 Two to four years in a client facing sales role within luxury services, wellness, aesthetics, hospitality or premium retail
 



  





 A record of carrying an individual revenue target, supported by specific examples of what was achieved and how
 



  





 Hands on working experience with an operational clinic, spa or salon management system such as Zenoti, covering appointment scheduling, client records, billing and package management. Working knowledge of a sales CRM is a further advantage
 



  





 Excellent spoken English, delivered with clarity, warmth and conviction
 



  





 Excellent written communication in English across WhatsApp and email, together with correct telephone etiquette
 



  





 A consultative approach to selling, based on establishing trust rather than applying pressure
 



  





 Willingness to work at the clinic and in front of clients for the full working day
 



  





 The ability to manage concurrent responsibilities, attending to a client in person while progressing follow ups, without compromising either
 



  





 Accuracy and discipline in billing, cash handling and record keeping
 



  





 A composed and presentable manner, particularly at times of high footfall
 



  





 A structured approach to problem solving where process is still being established
 



  





 Resilience and consistency in a target led environment with weekly reporting
 



  





 Preferred Background
 



  





 Client servicing or guest relations experience in a premium hotel, spa or clinic, followed by a move into a selling role, is the strongest background for this position. Candidates from luxury brands, wellness, beauty or aesthetics are equally encouraged to apply, and prior exposure to high net worth clientele in a service led environment will be considered a significant advantage. Candidates whose experience is limited to telephone based inside sales may find this position less suitable.
 



  





 What We Offer
 



  





 A front line position in a growing premium wellness brand, with ownership of the client experience from first contact to closed package
 



  





 A monthly incentive linked to revenue, in addition to fixed compensation
 



  





 A defined progression path to senior and leadership positions for consistent performers
 



  





 A collaborative working environment with direct access to leadership
 



  





 Additional Details
 



  





 Location: Santacruz West, Linking Road, Mumbai
 



  





 Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
 



  





 Working Pattern: Full time and on site, six days a week with one weekly off on rotation. The clinic is open all days
 



  





 Start Date: Immediate
 



  





 Compensation: Discussed at interview
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Please apply through LinkedIn with your curriculum vitae and a brief covering note. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an on site discussion.

**Summary**
 Imagine what you could do here. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionised entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry\-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. Our Apple Business and Education team supports our enterprises, governments, and educational institutions in transforming the way employees work and students learn. To realise this goal, we gain a deep understanding of the sectors we engage with—at all levels, from strategic to tactical. We create a vision that inspires our customers to transform their workplaces and campuses using the Apple ecosystem. We collaborate closely with internal and external partners to implement solutions and new use cases.
   

  

 As the Team Leader for our Field Engineers in India, you will lead, develop, and grow a world\-class expert team that solves technical and business problems to ensure success for Apple, our partners, and our customers. As a team of subject matter experts in India, you and your team will provide technical pre\-sales consulting with the goal of transforming the way people teach, learn, and work. Our team of Field Engineers helps to ensure the technical integrity of platforms, solutions, and apps developed for our customers to maximise the value of their investments in Apple products and services. You will also be a critical part of the India leadership team for business and education markets. You will work closely with worldwide and regional leadership and country teams, and you will serve as a thought leader for our strategic partners and alliances. This position will be located in Bangalore, Delhi, or Mumbai.
   

  

**Description**
 We are looking for an exceptional leader who will:
   

  

 Lead and develop a team of senior Field Engineers, focusing on developing strategies and plans to influence enterprises, governments, and educational institutions to invest in Apple technology while maximising the value for those investing in our ecosystem.
   

  

 Represent Apple by engaging with key executive stakeholders at our major customers and partners.
   

  

 Develop and implement strategies to position Apple technology effectively, and cultivate and leverage a robust ecosystem of partners.
   

  

 Establish relationships and partner with executive leadership at our strategic partners and solution providers.
   

  

 Provide technical leadership and consulting to the Apple sales teams, partners, and customers as you influence executives, faculty, and technical staff in a pre\-sales capacity.
   

  

 Architect, validate, demonstrate, and sell complete Apple hardware, software, and services solutions.
   

  

 Represent and advocate for India's technical priorities to internal stakeholders across Product Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Services organisations, establishing yourself as an expert and partner in a global organisation.
   

  

 Quickly master technical concepts, processes, details, and skills, and effectively communicate them to a wide variety of audiences.
   

  

 Provide encouragement and support to team members, including communicating individual and team goals, identifying areas for mentoring and guidance, and implementing development programmes for the team to build vital skills and knowledge to achieve performance targets.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Minimum of 20 years in leadership roles driving strategic technical consultancy for sales teams, partners, and customers.
* At least 5 years of proven leadership experience managing senior\-level teams, with a demonstrated ability to drive performance and innovation.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience leading pre\-sales technical or engineering teams. Experience managing a remote/geographically dispersed team is a plus. Background driving performance across a large region, country, or functional area is highly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of end\-user computing and complex technical solutions for the Enterprise and Education markets.
* Knowledge of Apple products, including managing Apple devices with multiple Mobile Device Management solutions.
* Familiarity with Apple Business Manager, Apple School Manager, and zero\-touch deployment, along with relevant certifications (e.g., ACSP, JAMF, Microsoft, Cisco) are a plus.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills. Ability to motivate and inspire others, articulate vision and purpose, and advocate for Apple’s values.
* Passion for continuous improvement with the curiosity to uncover gaps, resilience to manage ambiguity, and drive to optimise processes and create solutions.
* Excellent collaboration and relationship\-building skills, including the ability to influence cross\-functionally, navigate organisational structures, and manage complex relationships.
* Deep business acumen, strategic planning, and decision\-making skills; forward\-thinking mindset to analyse the market beyond the short term, foresee future possibilities, and translate data into plans, strategies, and action.
* Background in driving transformational change in both direct and channel sales is a plus.

Our customers around the globe rely on us for the information and tools they need to make critical investment decisions and remain connected across all sides of the financial community. And, to ensure the best experience for our 26,000\+ employees across more than 150 locations around the world, we provide the spaces and systems that allow our teams to work together with agility, productivity and collaboration, no matter where they are.
   

  

**What's the role?**
 Market Specialists support our Sales teams serving as subject matter experts within Bloomberg. On any given day in this role, you will be consulting with senior decision makers at client accounts, helping to close new sales opportunities, and providing critical feedback to help shape the development of our tools and services with the product management teams. By championing the Bloomberg Professional Service at market events and through printed material, you become the face of our company!
   

  

 The Market Specialists are comprised of a broad spectrum of individuals with varying backgrounds and skills with experience from the buy\-side, sell\-side, as well as market and industry participants. The team's core responsibility is not only to heighten our user base’s experience and impact sales revenue, but also play a vital role in improving the knowledge of our sales force, and are a dedicated source of client feedback for our product development teams. The team also highlight their market expertise through writing for a variety of publications or speaking at internal and external events.
   

  

 This role will be based in our Mumbai office.
   

  

**We'll Trust You To**
* Utilise your strong market experience, detailed knowledge of industry trends, and demonstrated technical skills to drive revenue opportunities across our suite of solutions
* Act in an advisory capacity to our clients around the challenges that they face, and how they can use our products and technology to solve them
* Develop an in depth understanding of the competitor landscape and how this affects both internal and external customers
* Influence the direction of Bloomberg products through thought leadership, contribution on innovative ideas, and establishing relationships between Bloomberg's decisions makers and our clients
* Develop and establish your own road\-map of initiatives based off your in depth understanding of markets, tools, and workflows that align with product, sales, and company goals, and then maintain check\-in points, and self\-report successes and challenges on these strategies
* Participate actively in new projects that drive departmental and firm\-wide initiatives and goals
* Seek out additional ways to make an impact, such as mentoring, involvement in training, running campaigns, and active involvement in product enhancement


**You'll Need To Have**
* Minimum 7 years of experience in Commodities in a sales, trading, or research capacity in the sell\-side or buy\-side
* The ability to convey complex ideas and solutions in a simple and concise way to audiences both large and small
* Strong communication skills to be able to credibly lead senior level client conversations, gain insight into clients' enterprise workflow and promote Bloomberg solutions
* The business insight required to use your knowledge and experience to make good judgement and quick decisions to tangibly impact the commercial success of our business
* A reciprocal and commercial approach, along with the ability to operate within both departmental and company\-wide initiatives, in a non\-hierarchical structure without corporate titles
* Excellent presentation, training, and communication skills in English


**If This Sounds Like You**
 Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime feel free to have a look at this:
   

  

**Why Bloomberg?**
 We’re individuals with diverse backgrounds, talents, and experiences who take on big challenges and create even bigger impact through our work. We’re interested in what makes you you, and how we can create opportunities for you to channel your unique, personal energy and grow to your fullest potential.
   

  

**Learn More About Our Office And Benefits**
 India \|
   

  

 Discover what makes Bloomberg unique \- watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

* Sales Execution: Demonstrated track record of independently managing the entire sales lifecycle from territory prospecting to complex contract closing.


**Bonus Points For**
* Advanced Business Education: Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Sales \& Marketing.

title: Enterprise Sales Director
description:
**Company Description** 
**DIMEAI IT SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED i** 
 s the creator of NonaShield, the world’s first unified mobile security infrastructure designed to deliver end\-to\-end protection in a single solution. Instead of relying on multiple point tools, NonaShield secures the full mobile lifecycle through one integrated engine. Its capabilities span device fingerprinting, runtime application self\-protection (RASP), behavioral analytics, and an AI\-native threat engine. The platform also provides network security, identity protection, and backend defense, helping organizations strengthen their mobile security posture. Joining DIMEAI offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of mobile cybersecurity innovation.
 



  





**Job description** 




  





 We are seeking a
 **Quota\-Crushing Enterprise Sales Partner** 
 who already owns relationships with CISOs, CTOs, Chief Risk Officers (CROs), and Heads of Fraud across Indian Fintechs, Digital NBFCs, Real\-Money Gaming (RMG), Neobanks, and Crypto platforms.
 



 This role is tailored for an independent dealmaker who rejects bureaucratic 12\-month sales cycles and thrives on executing fast 2\-to\-4\-week mid\-market closures. You will leverage a frictionless 14\-day "Shadow Mode" PoC to prove value on day one and earn high\-percentage deal commissions and milestone equity perks.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Drive Net\-New Revenue:** 
 Source, negotiate, and close high\-velocity enterprise deals across our two core channels:
* **Channel A (Digital Lending \& NBFCs):** 
 Solve synthetic loan origination, emulator farms, and first\-payment defaults.
* **Channel B (High\-Velocity Non\-Bank):** 
 Target RMG, Neo banking, Crypto, and Consumer, gaming, eCommerce , payment , upi Apps to eliminate multi\-accounting, bot farms, and location spoofing.
* **Execute Fast 30\-Day Closures:** 
 Target fast\-moving decision\-makers (Founders, CTOs, VP Engineering) who can sign contracts without multi\-layered committee delays.
* **Lead "Shadow Mode" PoC Conversions:** 
 Orchestrate lightweight 14\-day passive SDK audits that surface actual emulator and tampering leaks in client staging/production traffic, converting them directly into commercial agreements.



  




* **Displace Legacy Competitors:** 
 Out position browser\-heuristic fingerprinting and monolithic compliance wrappers by demonstrating sub\-15ms client latency, zero user friction, and unforgeable hardware\-backed attestation.
* **Commercial Negotiation:** 
 Structure flexible rolling monthly and annual agreements to eliminate legal and procurement friction.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* **Proven Dealmaking Track Record:** 
 8\+ years of experience selling software/infrastructure in Indian banking technology, payment rails (UPI, PG/PA, Switch), or cybersecurity.

 Direct, warm access to decision\-makers (CTO, CISO, Head of Engineering, CRO) across Indian lending apps, gaming platforms, and consumer fintechs.

* Mobile RASP, anti\-tamper, and root/jailbreak detection (Kernels, Magisk, Zygisk, Frida).

* Regulatory drivers: RBI Digital Lending Directions, Digital Payment Security Controls, NPCI Device Binding, and DPDP mandates.

 You do not rely on pre\-built marketing inbound funnels; you can pick up the phone, tap your network, send high\-signal LinkedIn notes, and book technical audits immediately.



**Compensation \& Commercial Perks** 



* **Aggressive Deal Commissions:** 
 High\-percentage commission (15%–20%\+) on first\-year Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) for every closed deal.
* **Cash Acceleration:** 
 Commissions paid out directly upon client invoice clearance.
* **Milestone Equity / Advisor Perks:** 
 Meaningful equity pool grants tied directly to closing the first 5 clients within the first 5 months.
* **Zero Bureaucracy:** 
 Direct founder access, immediate turnaround on technical SOWs/SDK sandboxes, and dedicated engineering support for all your active deals.

title: GTS Business Development Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**

**Global Trade Solutions** 
 ( GTS)
   

  

 Global Trade Solutions comprises over 4,500 people across more than 60 countries, helping suppliers and buyers with their export and import finance needs. Trade is where HSBC began in 1865, when we financed commerce between Europe, North America and Asia.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
* The role holder is responsible for consultative selling, implementation and management of GTS products to customers and prospects and managing existing GTS relationships to promote increased profitability and relationship depth, while minimizing risk
* They will develop new revenue streams by identifying and selling innovative GTS solutions to a portfolio of clients thus maximizing commercial profitability and relationship depth. This will include responsibility for pricing, reviewing and negotiating the full range of GTS services together with effecting any cost reduction initiatives required by the Group.
* Drives best practice in lending and risk policies ensuring this remains in line with economic and market practices


**Impact on the Business**
* To manage a client portfolio in order to maintain existing and generate new income for the business. Undertake sector/portfolio planning and client monitoring/contact
* Develop effective strategies for maintaining and growing a client portfolio in order to maintain and generate new income for the Group. This will involve initiatives such as sector planning and client/contact monitoring to ensure efforts and support GTS business objective
* Manage portfolio customers and follow end to end CM process as defined by Business Development Transformation
* To manage costs within plan, keep losses to a minimum and identify any cost reduction initiatives.
* Work closely with colleagues to promote awareness of GTS products, strategies and competitor information amongst the RM and other strategic business communities.
* Maintain awareness of the applicable regulatory and business environment: understand audit, tax and legal implications and changes as they affect he customers and the Bank.


**Customers / Stakeholders**
* Develop an appropriate calling plan to efficiently and effectively achieve goals and objectives. Through consultative selling, design and implement workable, innovative solutions for customers individual needs plus generate and receive quality referrals for/from other parts of the Group.
* Where appropriate undertake professional presentations etc. to customers in support of potential opportunities portraying HSBC in the best possible light against a backdrop of competition from local, regional and/or global banks.
* Maintain and enhance the image of HSBC through the planning and execution of conferences, industry sector days, internal \& external client road shows, active participation in industry associations and other such suitable events.
* Maintain close liaison with intra country, intra region and cross regional colleagues/stakeholders so as to provide input into the strategic direction of Sales, Product and Client Management functions Incremental revenue and customer satisfaction
* By matching customers’ requirements in response to proposal requests (RFP’s etc.)
* Provision of appropriate strategic business ideas based on awareness of market and industry initiatives and customer feedback. Sharing of best practices and to the overall direction of GTS regional and global business.


**Leadership \& Teamwork**
* Be a team player. Work with the team members and colleagues in order to perform the role the best of abilities.
* Demonstrating excellence in sales and following end to end sales process as defined internally
* Be self\-motivated and achieve results in the face of setbacks
* Keep management informed of progress/obstacles towards sales targets
* Establish an interactive dialogue process with Risk Management teams in order to build a sustainable asset growth
* By demonstrating and sharing best practices with colleagues.
* Sharing of feedback to appropriate stakeholders and colleagues
* By provision of commentary to team leader, senior client management, product and sales etc.


**Operational Effectiveness \& Control**
* Ensure compliance monitoring is in place in accordance with HSBC and regulatory standards.
* Ensure all CM Sales activity documentation is complete to provide performance tracking and targeting future sales efforts
* Continually assess the CM Sales processes to identify improvements
* Keep Team leader informed of any obstacles, issues etc.
* Compliance with and management of sales suitability risks and requirements
* Ensure all completed sales and prospecting activity documentation is appropriately completed, approved and stored to provide performance tracking, targeted future sales efforts and compliance with sales and transactional suitability guidelines and requirements
* Monitors own completion of mandatory training
* No unknown crisis issues
* Liaise with Client Service Teams, CoE inclusive, to certify a deliver an outstanding services to clients


**Major Challenges**
* Drive sales from existing clients and manage attrition
* Managing multiple time sensitive tasks
* Constantly evaluate \- Customer banking practices and trends in the market, GTS systems and techniques employed and the competitive market place.
* Adapting to a fast pace work environment and continually changing lines of communication, technological advances etc
* Ensuring RM community is sufficiently knowledgeable with GTS products/services/ regulation and having confidence they are able to continually apply this knowledge to their client base


**Role Context**
* GTS is a key strategic business for the HSBC Group under Corporate and Institutional Banking ( CIB) and its history is mixed with almost 150 years of Group history. HSBC is recognized worldwide as “the World's leading and largest trade bank and a Leading player in the receivables finance market” and its global leadership is unquestionable.
* Through capitalizing on the Group’s international network and on the regional expertise, GTS India not only consistently holds an important status internally as a reliable and relevant income generator as well externally receiving formal market recognition.
* The Group has defined International Trade as the highest priority area to explore business opportunities for next years, engaging all levels in the organization to position HSBC as the primary provider for Corporate clients for their international needs worldwide.
* Must have a thorough understanding of the GTS business and takes a long term view of expected changes
* To look for new sales opportunities, increase wallet share and generally ensure the performance of the client
* Ensure client satisfaction including identifying and dealing with actual or potential business or relationship risks


**Management of Risk**
* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.
* The jobholder will ensure the fair treatment of our customers is at the heart of everything we do, both personally and as an organisation.
* The jobholder will also continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology. Additionally they will ensure they effectively manage sales suitability, money laundering, counter terrorist financing, fraud, and reputational risk.
* This will be achieved by ensuring all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Also by addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with line management and/or the appropriate department


**Qualifications \- External**
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree / Graduation or as required for the role, whichever is higher
* Extensive knowledge of global trade finance, services, products and techniques.
* Extensive knowledge of the market \& market trends, competitive environment and regulatory environment.
* Detailed knowledge of GTS back and front office area
* Detailed knowledge if Credit \& Risk including techniques to mitigate risk
* Broad knowledge of HSBC Group companies and product ranges
* Sales \& Client Management experience at a senior level including dealing with senior executives plus a proven sales record
* Proven ability in identifying and meeting customer needs through matching a broad range of products and services
* Strong credit assessment skills, particularly with regard to more complex and structured facilities with an international dimension
* Proven ability to deliver creative and flexible customer solutions.
* Ability to understand a customers business and the fundamentals of running a business
* Good level of business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues
* Ability to interact with business customers at all levels
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Excellent time management, planning and organisation skills
* Excellent range of communication skills, including written, verbal, and the ability to deliver compelling presentations
* Strong analytical skills


**Desirable**
* GTS related industry qualifications


**Pro tip: Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.**
**Additional Notes**
 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Junior Business Development & Technical Support Engineer for Technical Training Systems
description:
**Company Description** 


 Adler \& Pfau India Private Limited is the Indian subsidiary of Germany\-based Adler \& Pfau GmbH. We develop educational programmes, technologies and infrastructure for international skills development and responsible global workforce mobility.
 





 Together with educational institutions, industrial partners and technology providers, we are establishing modern technical training solutions in India in the following areas:
 



* VR\-based welding training
* Solar and photovoltaic technology
* Driving simulators for cars and commercial vehicles
* Heat\-pump service\-technician training
* Air\-conditioning, refrigeration and HVAC training
* Digital and blended technical education



  






 We are looking for a motivated junior professional who would like to help build these new business areas from the ground up.
 




  




**Role Description** 


 As Junior Business Development \& Technical Support Engineer, you will support market development, customer acquisition, partner management and the technical implementation of our training systems in India.
 





 You will identify and approach prospective customers and cooperation partners, including:
 



* Industrial and vocational training institutes
* Engineering colleges, universities and polytechnics
* Welding and renewable\-energy training centres
* Driving schools, fleet operators and driver\-training centres
* HVAC and refrigeration training institutes
* Industrial companies and equipment manufacturers
* Governmental and private skills\-development organisations
* Trade associations and certification bodies




 You will introduce our solutions to prospective customers, understand their requirements and support presentations, demonstrations, pilot projects, installations and introductory training.
 





 During the market\-development phase, you will also serve as the first point of contact for basic technical and operational questions. Product and technical training will be provided by Adler \& Pfau and our technology partners.
 



**Technical Training Areas** 

**VR Welding Training** 





 Training systems combining VR simulation, theoretical education, practical welding instruction, trainer development and competency assessment.
 




**Solar and Photovoltaic Training** 





 Training covering PV fundamentals, planning, installation, commissioning, electrical safety, maintenance, troubleshooting, energy storage and EV charging.
 




**Driving Simulators** 





 Simulator\-based training for cars and commercial vehicles, including defensive driving, hazard perception, economical driving, fleet safety and professional\-driver qualification.
 




**Heat\-Pump Training** 





 Service\-technician training covering installation, electrical and hydraulic connections, commissioning, maintenance and fault diagnosis.
 




**Air\-Conditioning and HVAC Training** 





 Training covering installation, commissioning, refrigerant handling, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and energy\-efficient operation.
 





 Applicants are not expected to have expertise in all these fields. A strong technical interest and willingness to learn new technologies are more important.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
**Business Development and Sales Support** 
* Research potential customers and partners across India
* Approach training institutes, universities, companies and public organisations
* Introduce Adler \& Pfau’s technical training solutions
* Arrange and support online and on\-site presentations
* Assist with demonstrations, pilot projects and customer trials
* Understand and document customer requirements
* Help prepare proposals, quotations and presentations
* Maintain customer and partner information in the CRM system
* Follow up with prospective customers
* Conduct market and competitor research
* Support the development of regional partner networks
* Represent Adler \& Pfau India at trade fairs and educational events


**Partner Development** 
* Identify educational, industrial and technology partners
* Build relationships with training institutes, universities and companies
* Support cooperation agreements, pilot centres and demonstration facilities
* Help develop concepts combining simulation, digital learning, theory and practical instruction
* Coordinate activities with Indian and international partners
* Collect market feedback and support the adaptation of solutions to Indian requirements


**Technical Support** 
* Support demonstrations, installations and commissioning
* Assist customers with basic hardware, software, connectivity and configuration issues
* Provide introductory training to instructors, administrators and users
* Support remote and on\-site troubleshooting
* Document technical problems and coordinate complex cases with technology providers
* Maintain installation and customer documentation

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Sales Executive** 




  





***Posted by TheHireHub.AI on behalf of Bizpay***




  





**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
 



**Experience:** 
 3\-4 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Bizpay is a growing FinTech and payments SaaS company helping businesses operate more effectively through technology\-led financial solutions. As an organisation of 11–50 people, the company offers an environment where individual ownership, commercial judgment, and direct contribution are highly visible. This role will work within a focused revenue team and contribute directly to market reach, qualified pipeline, and growth. The company values people who can take responsibility for outcomes, learn quickly, and communicate confidently with business decision\-makers. Because the team is growing, this opportunity suits someone who wants meaningful ownership rather than a narrowly defined activity\-based role. You will engage with businesses, understand their priorities, and create relevant conversations for the sales organisation. The role is based onsite in Navi Mumbai and offers the chance to build a strong foundation in B2B SaaS and FinTech sales while working closely with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Own the top of the B2B SaaS sales funnel through targeted prospecting, qualification, meeting scheduling, and structured follow\-up. You will use LinkedIn, outbound email, cold calling, and prospecting tools to reach CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and other senior leaders. Success is measured by qualified prospects progressing to scheduled demos, with demos delivered by Account Executives and supported by strong SDR preparation. You will qualify business needs, provide useful context to the Account Executive, ensure prospects attend scheduled meetings, and continue follow\-ups after the demo to support opportunity progression. The role requires disciplined CRM usage, confident communication, strong data quality, and ownership of the prospect journey from first contact through post\-demo follow\-up.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain targeted prospect lists across relevant B2B segments, using account research and defined ideal\-customer criteria to improve outreach relevance and create stronger sales coverage.
* Execute multi\-channel outbound campaigns through LinkedIn, personalised emails, and cold calls, owning response quality, qualification, meeting conversion, and contribution to qualified pipeline.
* Engage confidently with CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and senior management by connecting business challenges to relevant SaaS and payments solutions.
* Research accounts and identify accurate decision\-makers, extracting phone numbers and email addresses through approved prospecting and data\-enrichment tools to improve contactability.
* Qualify prospects against agreed business, urgency, authority, need, and fit criteria, then schedule qualified demos for Account Executives with complete and accurate meeting context.
* Prepare Account Executives for scheduled demos by documenting prospect needs, stakeholders, use cases, objections, and agreed next steps in the CRM.
* Manage meeting confirmations, reminders, rescheduling, attendance, and timely follow\-ups so qualified prospects progress reliably through the sales process.
* Follow up with prospects after Account Executive demos, capture feedback and next steps, maintain momentum, and support conversion of qualified meetings into active opportunities.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Proven B2B SaaS outbound prospecting experience, with the ability to create qualified pipeline through disciplined LinkedIn outreach, email sequences, cold calling, and account\-based research.
* Strong executive communication skills, including confidence speaking with CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and other senior decision\-makers in concise, commercially relevant conversations.
* Practical experience building prospect lists and using LinkedIn, CRM platforms, email tools, databases, and contact\-enrichment systems to identify and verify business contacts.
* Strong understanding of qualification, discovery, objection handling, meeting scheduling, demo preparation, attendance management, and post\-demo follow\-up within a sales development process.
* Clear written communication for personalised email messaging, LinkedIn outreach, call scripts, meeting confirmations, follow\-ups, and concise Account Executive handoffs.
* Analytical and process\-oriented approach to measuring outreach, qualification, scheduled demos, attendance, post\-demo engagement, data quality, and pipeline contribution.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience selling FinTech, payments, HR technology, payroll, finance, or adjacent B2B SaaS solutions to mid\-market or enterprise organisations.
* Familiarity with sales engagement, CRM, LinkedIn automation, email verification, lead enrichment, and intent\-data tools used responsibly within outbound prospecting workflows.
* Existing understanding of CFO, HR, finance, or people\-operations priorities, enabling more relevant qualification and follow\-up with functional and executive stakeholders.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Three to four years of hands\-on experience in B2B SaaS sales development, outbound business development, lead generation, or a closely related role with measurable qualified\-meeting and pipeline outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to source accounts, identify relevant contacts, build prospect lists, qualify business needs, and execute consistent outreach across LinkedIn, email, and phone channels.
* Confidence communicating with senior business leaders, especially CFOs and HR heads, while adapting messaging to their priorities and earning credible demo conversations for Account Executives.
* Ownership mindset, resilience, and operating discipline: you follow through before and after demos, maintain accurate CRM records, and improve conversion through response and meeting data.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 Bizpay offers the opportunity to take visible ownership of revenue creation inside a growing FinTech and payments SaaS business. In a team of 11–50 people, your work will be closely connected to commercial outcomes, giving you direct exposure to sales strategy, customer needs, and the systems that turn market interest into qualified demos and pipeline. This is a role for someone who wants to do more than execute scripts. You will shape target lists, test messaging, qualify business problems, schedule meetings for Account Executives, and maintain momentum after demos. You will use performance data to improve qualification, attendance, and conversion. The onsite setup in Navi Mumbai supports close collaboration with sales leadership and faster learning through real customer conversations. You will also build valuable experience across B2B SaaS, payments, finance, and HR\-related business problems. The company provides a setting where initiative is visible, high\-quality execution matters, and strong performers can grow with the business as its market reach expands.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* A visible revenue ownership opportunity within a growing FinTech and payments SaaS company, with direct responsibility for qualified demos, pipeline contribution, and prospect progression.
* An onsite, collaborative working environment in Navi Mumbai where you can learn closely with Account Executives and sales leadership through real prospect conversations.
* Competitive compensation and the opportunity to build deeper expertise in B2B SaaS outbound sales, executive engagement, qualification, demo coordination, and structured follow\-up.
